headline: Google Pixel 11 phones up to $350 off through November 8th
summary: Save big on the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL. The Pixel 11 Pro with 256GB storage is now just $799.99.
details: Google's Pixel 11 series is available at significant discounts, with savings of up to $350 on all models. This sale presents a prime opportunity to acquire a high-quality Android phone at a reduced price.

The Pixel 11 Pro, originally priced at $1,099.99 for the 256GB storage and 12GB RAM configuration, is now available for $799.99 at major retailers including Amazon, Best Buy, and the Google Store. This deal surpasses its previous Prime Day pricing.

The base Pixel 11 model is also on offer, priced at $699.99, marking a $200 discount. This makes it a competitive option, matching the post-price-bump cost of the iPhone 17E and offering Google's exclusive software features like Magic Capture and Proactive Assistance.

For those seeking the largest display and longest battery life, the Pixel 11 Pro XL is also included in the sale with substantial price reductions. Trade-in offers for older Pixel models are reportedly generous, further sweetening the deal for those looking to upgrade.
